storagePolicies.with_check:
((bucket_id = 'career-insights'::text) AND ((storage.foldername(name))[1] = 'career-insights'::text) AND ((storage.foldername(name))[2] = ( SELECT (auth.uid())::text AS uid)) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM (profiles p
     JOIN coaches c ON ((c.profile_id = p.id)))
  WHERE ((p.id = ( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid)) AND ((p.role)::text = 'coach'::text) AND (p.status = 'active'::text) AND ((c.application_status)::text = 'approved'::text) AND (c.approved_at IS NOT NULL)))))
